note: Named carries for the fleet watertight gate (tools/watertight-carry.mjs, read by the watertight audit fleetPassDefault runs). Hand-edited. Each row is a hull that leaks past the 0.05 L gate with its shipped interior fills: leakL is its leak volume in litres at the measurement resolution (0.01 L), with the owner who clears it, the date it was carried and the cause. The gate passes a listed hull at exactly its leakL (229 ratchet: below fails until the row is lowered) and fails on any unlisted leak, any listed hull that measures more, and any listed hull that now holds water (delete its row). Lower or delete rows; never raise one to turn a red green. Seeded 2026-10-16 from the 32 hulls that leaked at the 226 freeze (57600d613) and read the same volumes at the final 226 gate (4edd0e686); coordinator ruling 2026-10-16 14:35: a named 226 carry, the first job of the 227 regen.
